title: SavedSearch
description: plinth.saved_search/1, from api.saved_search_save(p_query, p_name, p_in_digest, p_id, p_client_id) (API_CONTRACTS §3.2; built by T45a). The search as saved (app.saved_searches). The same query saved again updates the one saved search; at most 25 per buyer. Matches are digest material, never utility alerts.

name.description: The buyer's own name for it (at most 80 characters).

query.description: The search as the client sent it in p_query (what was asked, without the page: q, filters, sort, bbox).
